jyutping: A ling6 jan4 lyun4 soeng2 dou3 B

english.note: Use this when something evokes an association or underlying idea, rather than simply stating what it means.

examples.english: This song can connote the days when we were growing up.
examples.traditional: 呢首歌令人聯想到我哋細個嗰段日子。
